MeshOptimiser v0.15.0

The current code as a zip, straight from GitHub. Free, open source, MIT licence. Windows and macOS.

Download .zip View on GitHub What is new in v0.15.0

Get started

Unzip, start, drop a file.

  1. 01

    Download and unzip

    Unpack the folder anywhere. There is no installer: everything, its Python environment included, lives in that folder.

  2. 02

    Start it

    The first run sets up its Python environment and downloads what it needs, then opens the viewer. After that it starts in about a second.

  3. 03

    Drop a file

    Drop a .step or .stp file on the start screen, or run the converter from the command line.

Windows
start.bat
macOS
./start.command
Command line
python step2glb.py input.step --meshopt

Requirements

What it needs.

Troubleshooting
Python
3.10, 3.11 or 3.12. 3.13 doesn’t work yet, because cadquery-ocp doesn’t support it.
Browser
One with WebGPU: a recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
Disk
About 2 GB free for the Python environment the first time.
Network
Not needed to run. The viewer’s libraries come with the app, and only a few rarely used converters are fetched when you ask for them.
